entries.translation_en: Welcome to the rift between<LINE>consciousness and<LINE>unconsciousness. <CLOSE><PAGE>I am Philemon... a guide to the<LINE>human soul.
Every mortal wears a mask to<LINE>face the harsh trials of<LINE>reality.<PAGE>That mask of resolve... is the<LINE>power known as Persona.<PAGE>Awaken, young traveler!
Remember your true name... and<LINE>remember the vow you made in the<LINE>light. <CLOSE><PAGE>Go forth, and let your Persona<LINE>illuminate the shadows.
